experiment.conclusion: Held-out test period from 2025-10-05 (139257 pairs): raw model RMSE 0.427 m, bias -0.256 m, HH 0.287. Persistence reference RMSE 0.626 m on 138758 pairs; raw skill vs persistence +0.535. Climatology reference RMSE 0.553 m on 124979 pairs; raw skill vs climatology +0.438. rf: validation RMSE 0.385 m; test RMSE 0.320 m (-25.0% vs raw), bias +0.086 m, HH 0.192; passes every deployment criterion. gbt: validation RMSE 0.395 m; test RMSE 0.322 m (-24.7% vs raw), bias +0.092 m, HH 0.192; passes every deployment criterion. linear: validation RMSE 0.403 m; test RMSE 0.335 m (-21.5% vs raw), bias +0.088 m, HH 0.201; passes every deployment criterion. Deployable (passed on held-out data): linear, rf, gbt.
